text:
zoe: Quick heads-up: we rolled out the stream-aware-batcher canary. TL;DR: p50 ~0%, p95 -10%, p99 -28%, est token-cost -9% on streaming-heavy workloads for gpt-chat-v3. :tada:

zoe: What changed: batcher now classifies requests into stream vs non-stream lanes and maintains a short holding window for stream-starts so we can coalesce initial tokens without adding tail latency to non-stream traffic. Also added a fallback that forces single-request decode for tool-call flows to avoid premature coalescing.

mike: Bench numbers?

zoe: Canary replay (1% sampled trace + synthetic streams):
```
baseline: p50 37ms p95 145ms p99 490ms cost=1.00
canary : p50 37ms p95 130ms p99 353ms cost=0.91
```

arthur: Any quality or tool-calling regressions caught?

zoe: Ran our streaming evals and tool-call harness. No semantic regressions. A tiny set of edge cases where tools expecting immediate first-token callbacks were delayed ~20ms; fixed by the forcing rule for tool flows.

mike: Infra issues? memory, batcher jitter?

zoe: Observed a short-lived spike in microbatch variance during the first 15 minutes; we tuned the hold-window to 12ms and that smoothed coalescence without hurting p50. No OOMs or driver issues.

deploy-bot: deploy: stream-aware-batcher/v1 -> canary on pool-gpu-streams (4 instances) at 2025-11-01T09:03:12Z

arthur: Rollout plan and ops commands?

zoe: Rollout: 2% -> 8% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with automated rollback on p99 regress or tool-call error rate >0.1%. Ops commands:
```
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-streams --tag stream-aware-batcher/v1 --pct 2
sleep 3600
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-streams --tag stream-aware-batcher/v1 --pct 8
```

mike: Please upload eval CSVs to the benchmarks bucket and add a console metric for "stream-coalesce hit rate" and "tool-flow single-decode rate".

zoe: Done: s3://ci-redwood/benchmarks/stream-aware-batcher/v1. Console tickets filed. Dedicated customers: opt-in only, product will coordinate. Closing: tracking rollout and will post updates here.
